Games with a video in their page media rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age

new.statement: Young games whose thumbnails show gameplay hold higher Top Trending positions among games of similar age, even though they climb more slowly

Asymmetric two-player co-op, where one player sees and the other acts (rally driver and navigator, scooter driver and passenger), is a new wave reaching Up-and-Coming and Top Trending within two weeks of launch
new.rationale: Rally Panic! (+30 Up-and-Coming, new on Top Trending at 16 days), Backseat Rally (new on Up-and-Coming at 13 days) and Scooter Duo all split one vehicle between two roles; Rally Panic credits Left Left LEFT! as its inspiration. A role-split feature from the description would test it, and the wave should fade within weeks if it is a fad.

new.statement: Hand-painted makeup games (a bare face canvas you paint layer by layer) form a cluster on Up-and-Coming, and the round-based, rated versions rank above the solo studio versions
new.action: Add rating rounds to creative tools
new.rationale: Facecard: Makeup Showdown is among the best on Up-and-Coming and Makeup Salon entered both Up-and-Coming and Top Trending with 98% likes, while the solo Makeup Star (57% likes) and VANITY sit lower; all are 13–14 days old. Comparing rated-round and solo versions over the next weeks would confirm or reject it.

qualitative_updates.note: Kukirin Life is Top Earning #42, Most Popular #41 (+8) and Up-and-Coming #6 at 29 days; Escooter Life entered Top Earning at 7 days; ScootX and Bike Universe joined Up-and-Coming, though Redlane and Scooter Empire sit low on it.

Mixed: DIVINE HATCHERS, Lift Rock For Eggs and Pogo For Animals fell 41–55 places while Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular, but Fake an Egg (+24 Top Trending) and Bike For Egg (+29 Up-and-Coming) rose.
Sequence counts keep their order: tt→mp 62 (median 2 days), uc→tt 59 (2 days), te→tt 48 (7 days).
